# laminar_signal (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laminar Signal by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laminar_signal" "failure_detector" {
  name = "Failure detector"
}

output "failure_detector_id" {
  value = data.laminar_signal.failure_detector.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Signal UUID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Exact Signal name. Signal names are unique within a project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the Signal is paused.
- `filters` (Attributes List) Conditions a trace must match to be evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `llm_profile_id` (String) Self-hosted only. LLM profile UUID.
- `llm_profile_name` (String) LLM profile name.
- `mode` (String) Processing mode.
- `model` (String) Self-hosted only. Model name.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project that owns the Signal.
- `prompt` (String) Evaluation instructions.
- `sample_rate` (Number) Percentage of matching traces evaluated; null when every trace is evaluated.
- `structured_output` (String) JSON Schema of the Signal result.
- `trigger` (Attributes) When the Signal is evaluated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))
- `version` (Number) Server-managed configuration version.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `column` (String) Trace column.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator.
- `value` (String) Scalar value.
- `values` (List of String) List value.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Read-Only:

- `span_names` (List of String) Span names for `spanName` triggers.
- `type` (String) Trigger type.
